chapters.title: Welcome to Unity
chapters.description: Discover what Unity is, set up the engine, and take your first steps into the world of real-time 3D development.

chapters.title: The Unity Editor
chapters.description: Master the interface: Scene view, Game view, Hierarchy, Inspector, Project window, and more. Learn to customize your workspace.

chapters.title: GameObjects & Transforms
chapters.description: Understand the building blocks of every Unity scene. Manipulate position, rotation, scale, and parent-child relationships.

chapters.title: Components & Materials
chapters.description: Add behavior with components. Apply colors and textures using materials. Introduction to shaders and how rendering works.

chapters.title: Introduction to Scripting
chapters.description: Write your first C# scripts! Learn the fundamentals of coding in Unity, attach scripts to objects, and use Debug.Log.

chapters.title: Variables & Data Types
chapters.description: Store and manipulate data using variables. Explore int, float, string, bool, and Unity's Vector3. Use public fields and serialization.

chapters.title: Control Flow
chapters.description: Make decisions and repeat actions with if‑else, switch, for, while, and foreach loops. Add enums for clean state management.

chapters.title: Functions & Methods
chapters.description: Organize your code with methods. Understand parameters, return types, overloading, and the special role of Start() and Update().

chapters.title: MonoBehaviour Lifecycle
chapters.description: Deep dive into Awake, Start, Update, FixedUpdate, LateUpdate, OnEnable, and OnDisable. Master the execution order.

chapters.title: Input & Movement
chapters.description: Read keyboard, mouse, and gamepad input. Use Input Manager axes to move objects smoothly in 2D and 3D.

chapters.title: Physics & Collisions
chapters.description: Add Rigidbody, colliders, and physics materials. Detect collisions and triggers with OnCollisionEnter and OnTriggerEnter.

chapters.title: UI & Canvas
chapters.description: Build menus and HUDs with Canvas, Text, Button, Image, and Slider. Use anchors and RectTransform for adaptive layouts.

chapters.title: Animation & Animator
chapters.description: Create animation clips, control them with the Animator controller, and blend between states using parameters.

chapters.title: Audio
chapters.description: Bring your game to life with Audio Sources and Audio Listeners. Play 2D and 3D sounds via scripts.

chapters.title: Building & Publishing
chapters.description: Configure build settings, player settings, and export your game to PC, mobile, and WebGL.
